summary: Wired two optional community scrapers already expected by merge.OPTIONAL_COMMUNITY_SOURCES. Insert Coin reverse-indexes Music-genre catalog titles via the public backend API (locationGames.game.uuid filter) into 2425 merge-ready venues with 100% coords and game_counts. Timezone scrapes official AU/NZ/SG/PH/ID list pages into 226 address-only chain rows (no cab lists; lat/lng left null because CMS map pins are sparse and often wrong).
how_to_verify: python scrapers/insert_coin.py --smoke  (expect venues from top Music titles; nothing written)
python scrapers/insert_coin.py --out data_raw  (writes data_raw/insert_coin.json; ~255 Music titles, several minutes)
python scrapers/timezone.py --out data_raw  (writes data_raw/timezone.json; 5 list pages)
python scrapers/run_all.py --only insert_coin  (optional path via OPTIONAL_SCRAPERS)

python -c "import json; ic=json.load(open('data_raw/insert_coin.json',encoding='utf-8')); tz=json.load(open('data_raw/timezone.json',encoding='utf-8')); print(len(ic), len(tz), len({r['sid'] for r in ic})==len(ic))"
python scrapers/merge.py  (with both raw files present; optional loaders should print loaded counts)
risks: Insert Coin is crowdsourced (often seeded from ZIv). Treat as secondary to allnet/eagate/ziv for name/coords priority (SRC_PRIORITY 7+).
game_counts count distinct IC title versions mapped to a slug at a venue (e.g. two maimai DX versions => maimai_dx:2), not physical cabinet units.
Timezone locator has zero per-venue music cab lists. Rows are games=['other'] for venue existence / address hygiene only.
Timezone Google Maps pins on detail pages are often missing or point at sibling stores. Default scrape is list-only (lat/lng null). --detail is opt-in and still sparse.
Full insert_coin crawl paginates ~64 game pages then ~255 Music titles (polite 0.4s sleep). Runtime is several minutes; do not smoke-test with full.
API Accept header must be application/json (application/ld+json returns 406). GeoJSON list is id+coords only.

api_notes.insert_coin_locations_json: GET /api/locations?pagination=false Accept: application/json -> 7650 full name/address rows (country filters ignored)
api_notes.insert_coin_game_filter: GET /api/locations?locationGames.game.uuid={uuid}&itemsPerPage=1000 works; used for reverse index
api_notes.timezone_list_html: venue-details cards: venue-suburb name, venue-address, activity tooltips; path /en-{cc}/venues|locations/{region}/{slug}/
